summary: VDD execution-plan skill routes standalone requirements to direct implementation; explicit complete-directory create/repair only. Select standard/resumable/self-hosted profile before model routing; ordinary routes Sol/high, typed complex recovery only Sol/max with capability probes. Required authority and knowledge preflight/input-gate sequences precede plan-ready. Lifecycle: draft -> plan-ready -> implementation-authorized -> implementation-complete -> acceptance-passed -> archived; VDD owns early states, Quick Dev only implementation-complete. Plans require observable acceptance, declared failure intent, GREEN target, dependents, recovery, baseline/scope identity, targeted checks, and terminal full validation. No newly authored RED artifacts or legacy RED manufacture. Repairs are in-place under repair/round-n, preserve immutable history, bind findings/scope/hashes/receipts, require callsite inventory and composition checks; Bootstrap lineage budget default two, max three with typed triggers, exhaustion manual_pause. Resumable/self-hosted require append-only 95 report/index. Standard omits extra books/reports unless needed. Bootstrap is optional supplemental evidence and never lifecycle publication; P2-only findings do not open new semantic rounds. Current plan directory remains acceptance target unless explicit supersede/incompatible scope.
